sloka: प्रियां बहुमतां भार्यां वनवासमनुव्रताम् ।भर्त्सितां तर्जितां वापि नानुमंस्यति राघवः ।।। ५.२७.४०।।।।
transliteration: priyāṁ bahumatāṁ bhāryāṁ vanavāsamanuvratām ।bhartsitāṁ tarjitāṁ vāpi nānumaṁsyati rāghavaḥ ।।। 5.27.40।।।।

translations.english: "Rama will not approve of any one abusing or threatening his venerable, beloved wife, who had led a life of exile with him.
